# Test fixture

`model-selection-catalog.json` is a catalog-v1 file that uses real model names. Every Smart, Time, and Cost value is random test data and must not be interpreted as a real benchmark result.

The fixture is freely redistributable and intentionally contains:

- Thirteen Pareto-efficient variants
- One strictly dominated variant
- Low, medium, and high variants of GPT-5.5 with progressively higher fabricated intelligence, time, and cost
- Source origins for Smart, Fast, and Cheap metrics
- Valid adjusted Fast and Cheap origins using `median-overlap-ratio`
